question:
An engineer is running an ACI fabric, has VMM integration with VMware vCenter, and wants to enable microsegmentation based on vCenter VM attributes.
Which statement describes microsegmentation in this scenario?
options: ACI does not support microsegmentation based on vCenter VM attributes. The network attributes should be used for microsegmentation.
When enabled, microsegmentation performs distributed switching and routing on the ESXi hosts.
Microsegmentation is supported only using AVE or AVS.
An ACI microsegmented EPG automatically creates a port group with a private VLAN configured on a VMware vCenter distributed virtual switch.
